native.iec101_implementation: Actual implementation/revision, independently selected from industry.
native.iec101_configuration_phase: Actual configured profile versus explicit constructor/user-guide example proposals.
native.iec101_role: Actual controlling/controlled station. Application role differs from primary/secondary link direction.
native.iec101_link_mode: Balanced point-to-point peers versus unbalanced controlling station polling multiple addressed stations.
native.iec101_physical: Actual serial realization; RS232/RS485/modem limits are not Ethernet link speeds.
native.iec101_serial_binding: Actual canonical serial port/segment and all peers.
native.iec101_device_source: Actual device/firmware revision, serial and FT1.2 support.
native.iec101_interoperability_source: Actual common agreement on link addressing, ASDU sizes/types/COT and encodings.
native.iec101_physical_source: Actual transceiver/modem, wiring/termination, propagation, turnaround and serial clock bounds.
native.iec101_type_source: Actual ASDU type/quality/time/content interpretation; no invented payload encoding.
native.iec101_command_source: Actual select/execute/cancel/ACT_CON/ACT_TERM and timeout acceptance, separate from link ACK.
native.iec101_address_source: Actual link station, common ASDU and information-object address mapping, independently assigned.
native.iec101_baud_bps: Actual serial bit rate; ABB19200 is a device default, lib9600 is a user-guide example, neither a universal mode maximum.
native.iec101_data_bits: Actual serial octet size, FT1.2 normal profile8 bits; other device settings need a separate proven encoding.
native.iec101_parity: Actual parity; Even proposal for qualified profiles, not CAN CRC or arbitrary no-parity default.
native.iec101_stop_bits: Actual1/2 stop bits for configured serial port.
native.iec101_character_bits: Actual start+data+optional parity+stop bits per character; not8 payload bits per wire byte.
native.iec101_link_address_bytes: Actual FT1.2 link address length. Balanced interoperability can omit it; unbalanced needs1/2 bytes.
native.iec101_link_address: Actual link_address in configured link-width; broadcast purpose explicit and never a station-default1.
native.iec101_peer_link_address: Actual peer_link_address in configured link-width; broadcast purpose explicit and never a station-default1.
native.iec101_address_purpose: Actual addressed station or broadcast; broadcast is all ones for configured address width.
native.iec101_balanced_dir: Actual balanced DIR bit; opposite peer directions required, unrelated to unbalanced PRM.
native.iec101_peer_balanced_dir: Actual balanced peer DIR bit, not inferred from industry or device name.
native.iec101_function_code: Actual4-bit FT1.2 function code; valid state/role-specific actions require link-layer evidence.
native.iec101_frame_kind: Actual variable-data, fixed-control or single-character E5 ACK; each has different wire length.
native.iec101_single_char_ack: Actual enabled single-character E5 acknowledgement for eligible responses; not application success.
native.iec101_length_l: Actual duplicated variable-length L: control+link address+ASDU bytes; one-byte ceiling255, not total-wire-byte ceiling255.
native.iec101_peer_length_limit: Actual peer accepted L limit, not Ethernet MTU. ABB documented230 is a device proposal.
native.iec101_wire_bytes: Actual full FT1.2 octets including length/start/checksum/stop; variableL+6, fixedaddress+4, singleACK1.
native.iec101_type_id_bytes: Actual agreed type_id_bytes width; common address/COT/IOA differ and must match peers.
native.iec101_vsq_bytes: Actual agreed vsq_bytes width; common address/COT/IOA differ and must match peers.
native.iec101_cot_bytes: Actual agreed cot_bytes width; common address/COT/IOA differ and must match peers.
native.iec101_ca_bytes: Actual agreed ca_bytes width; common address/COT/IOA differ and must match peers.
native.iec101_ioa_bytes: Actual agreed ioa_bytes width; common address/COT/IOA differ and must match peers.
native.iec101_common_address: Actual ASDU common address, not link address or Ethernet endpoint.
native.iec101_originator: Actual COT originator when COT2; absent for COT1, not confirmed constructor placeholder0.
native.iec101_first_ioa: Actual first information object address for its configured1/2/3 byte width.
native.iec101_type_id: Actual one-byte ASDU type identifier; private types require agreed content definition.
native.iec101_cot: Actual6-bit cause of transmission; test/negative flags are separate.
native.iec101_test: Actual ASDU test flag; not a silently disabled production requirement.
native.iec101_negative: Actual negative confirmation flag, not a bus transmission failure probability.
native.iec101_sequence: Actual SQ contiguous objects with one IOA versus individual-address objects.
native.iec101_object_count: Actual7-bit VSQ object count; consecutive SQ addresses must fit IOA width.
native.iec101_object_bytes: Actual encoded bytes per fixed-size object excluding IOA, including type-specific quality/time.
native.iec101_objects_encoded_bytes: Actual full information-object encoding incl addresses; variable-size types require explicit encoded total.
native.iec101_object_layout: Actual fixed-size objects versus variable/private content; no generic8-byte assumption.
native.iec101_asdu_bytes: Actual full ASDU header+encoded information objects, separate from FT1.2 L/wire size.
native.iec101_asdu_limit: Actual peer/library ASDU limit; lib constructor249 is qualified, not universal255 payload.
native.iec101_byte_order: IEC101 Mode1 least-significant octet first; explicit application float/text encodings remain type-specific.
native.iec101_ack_timeout_ms: Actual ack_timeout_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_repeat_timeout_ms: Actual repeat_timeout_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_link_state_timeout_ms: Actual link_state_timeout_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_idle_timeout_ms: Actual idle_timeout_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_poll_interval_ms: Actual poll_interval_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_class1_poll_bound_ms: Actual class1_poll_bound_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_class2_poll_bound_ms: Actual class2_poll_bound_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_turnaround_ms: Actual turnaround_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_cts_delay_ms: Actual cts_delay_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_receiver_enable_delay_ms: Actual receiver_enable_delay_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_command_confirmation_ms: Actual command_confirmation_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_select_execute_ms: Actual select_execute_ms in its own link/poll/command scope; hardware-specific response/recovery evidence required.
native.iec101_class1_queue: Actual device/implementation class1_queue capacity or retry budget; no shared queue256 or guaranteed recovery.
native.iec101_class2_queue: Actual device/implementation class2_queue capacity or retry budget; no shared queue256 or guaranteed recovery.
native.iec101_retry_limit: Actual device/implementation retry_limit capacity or retry budget; no shared queue256 or guaranteed recovery.
native.iec101_carrier_detect_required: Actual serial carrier gating; ABB balanced/unbalanced defaults differ.
native.iec101_command_procedure: Actual direct execute versus select-before-operate with matching controlled-station acceptance.
native.iec101_time_format: Actual ASDU time representation; short clock information is not a complete timestamp.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded application data; separate type/header/IOA, FT1.2 control/link address/L/checksum/start/stop lengths and agreed device limits. No255-byte universal application payload or inherited Ethernet MTU.
